name: GitHub
description: Connect your GitHub account to inspect repositories, read project files, and create issues. Every write action is separately approval-gated.

name: Google Workspace
actions: Gmail: search, read, draft and send email
Calendar: read events, check availability and manage schedules
Drive: find, read, upload and organize files
Docs and Sheets: create, read and edit documents and spreadsheets
Contacts, Tasks and Meet: access supported workspace tools
description: Connect one Google account through Google's OAuth consent screen. Google Super unifies Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Contacts, Tasks, Meet and other supported Google services in one connection. ULTRON never asks for your Google password; write actions remain approval-gated.

name: Notion
actions: Read pages, comments and database rows
Create and update pages, blocks and database entries
description: Connect a Notion workspace through OAuth. ULTRON can search and read pages, wikis and databases; creating, editing, archiving or sharing content requires an explicit owner permission for the exact tool.

name: Dropbox
actions: Upload, move, rename and share files
description: Connect your Dropbox account through OAuth. ULTRON can search and read files within granted access; uploads, moves, sharing and deletions require an explicit owner permission for the exact tool.

name: Slack
actions: Draft and send messages, manage channels
description: Connect a Slack workspace through OAuth. ULTRON can search and read accessible conversations; sending messages, inviting users, changing channels or deleting content requires an explicit owner permission for the exact tool.

name: Linear
description: Connect a Linear workspace through OAuth. ULTRON can search and read project context; creating, updating, assigning or archiving issues requires an explicit owner permission for the exact tool.
